messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Bym.map() function
parts:
On 22 November 2012 15:57, Lennon <lenno...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Anyone know where is the Bym.map() function in the examples on:
>
> http://www.r-inla.org/examples/volume-1/code-for-bym-example

From the third line of that file you can figure out where the code is
for your INLA installation:

> system.file("demodata/Bym-map.R", package="INLA")
[1] "/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/INLA/demodata/Bym-map.R"

(Bym.map() is a trivial wrapper for germany.map() which is also
defined in that file.)

/Finn
